summary.en: China's women's basketball team crushed Indonesia 110-41 in the Asian Games group stage to secure first place in Group A. 张子宇 had 22 points and 5 rebounds, 刘禹彤 posted a 20-point, 10-rebound double-double, and 罗欣棫 added 17 points and 6 assists. In other action, Korea beat Mongolia 88-61 and Chinese Taipei downed Malaysia 98-59 for their second straight win.

summary.zh_hant: 名古屋亞運會女籃小組賽，中國女籃以110比41大勝印尼，鎖定A組第一名。張子宇攻下22分5籃板，劉禹彤20分10籃板拿下兩雙，羅欣棫貢獻17分6助攻。同日韓國88比61戰勝蒙古，中國台北98比59擊敗馬來西亞取得兩連勝。

It was Haughey's second medal in Nagoya after the previous night's relay silver.

summary.en: Hong Kong's women fell 1-2 to Uzbekistan in their final Asian Games group match on September 21. Substitute 魏嵐 levelled in the 66th minute after a first-half deficit, but goalkeeper 吳卓蔚 conceded a stoppage-time penalty that sealed the defeat. Three straight losses, following 1-5 to China and 0-2 to the Philippines, ended Hong Kong's campaign without a point.

summary.en: The HKFA announced a 40-man preliminary squad on September 21 for Hong Kong's opening 2027 Asian Cup qualifier away to Singapore. All eight mainland-based CSL players plus China League One duo 余在言 and 吳宇曦 were selected, while injured Kitchee midfielder 陳俊樂 also made the cut. The squad gathers on October 17, plays a home friendly on the 19th and departs for Singapore on the 21st ahead of the match on the 25th.

Thailand had won the Asian Championship and the direct Los Angeles Olympics berth.

summary.en: Hong Kong's men completed an unbeaten weekend at the Asia Rugby Sevens Series leg in Hangzhou, thrashing Japan 31-12 in the final with tries from Bryn Phillips, Harry Sayers, Sebastian Brien, 房傑鋒 and Liam Herbert. summary.en: Shen Xiaoyu scored 9.713 points to win the women's changquan event at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, giving the Hong Kong delegation its first gold of the Games. The flag bearer was competing at her third Asian Games and entered only the changquan event. She previously won the wushu title at the 2025 Chengdu World Games and finished runner-up at this year's Wushu Taolu World Cup.

summary.en: Manchester City beat Sunderland 5-3 in a thriller at the Etihad on Sept 20, with goals from Enzo Fernandez, Rayan Cherki, Antoine Semenyo (2) and Erling Haaland, while Brian Brobbey's hat-trick was in vain for the visitors. City are the only side in England's top four divisions with a 100% record, three points clear at the top. Enzo Maresca became only the sixth manager to win his first five Premier League games in charge.

summary.en: Atletico Madrid beat Real Madrid 2-1 in the Madrid derby on Sept 20. Dean Huijsen conceded a penalty and was sent off in the 52nd minute, Alejandro Grimaldo converted from the spot, and Jonathan David headed in Giuliano Simeone's cross on 59 minutes before Antonio Rudiger's late reply. It was Jose Mourinho's first derby since returning to Real, who dropped to fourth, six points behind Barcelona.
summary.zh_hans: 9月20日西甲马德里德比，马竞主场以2比1击败皇家马德里。赫伊森在52分钟送点球兼领红牌被逐，格里马尔多操刀命中，乔纳森·戴维59分钟接应小西蒙尼传中扩大比分，吕迪格89分钟为皇马破蛋。这是穆里尼奥重返皇马后首场德比，皇马落后榜首巴塞罗那6分跌至第四。
summary.zh_hant: 9月20日西甲馬德里打吡，馬體會主場以2比1擊敗皇家馬德里。侯辛在52分鐘送十二碼兼領紅牌被逐，基馬度操刀命中，莊拿芬大衛59分鐘接應基奧蘭奴施蒙尼傳中擴大比數，魯迪加89分鐘為皇馬破蛋。這是摩連奴重返皇馬後首場打吡，皇馬落後榜首巴塞隆拿6分跌至第四。

title.en: Madrid derby: Atletico beat 10-man Real Madrid 2-1 as Jonathan David strikes winner

summary.en: Liverpool won 1-0 at Bournemouth on Sept 20, Alexander Isak converting Cody Gakpo's cross in the 57th minute for his fourth league goal in five games. Alisson denied Evanilson to preserve the clean sheet. Andoni Iraola marked his return to his former club with three points as unbeaten Liverpool headed into the international break in sixth.

title.en: Isak strikes as Liverpool win 1-0 at Bournemouth on Iraola's return

summary.en: AC Milan beat Lecce 3-0 at San Siro on Sept 20, with Christian Pulisic opening the scoring in the 14th minute, Adrien Rabiot doubling the lead on 61 minutes and Diego Moreira sealing it in the 73rd. The Rossoneri stayed firmly in the title race with a comfortable victory.

title.en: AC Milan cruise past Lecce 3-0 as Pulisic opens the scoring

summary.en: George Russell won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix on Sept 20, beating Max Verstappen by just 0.196 seconds in Baku. It was another statement victory for Russell this season, with the pair fighting to the final lap on the street circuit.

summary.en: Pedro Acosta won his first-ever MotoGP race at the Austrian Grand Prix on Sept 20. The young Spaniard was superb at the Red Bull Ring, finally converting his prodigious talent into a premier-class victory.

summary.en: Team Europe defeated Team World 13-5 to win the 2026 Laver Cup in San Francisco on Sept 20. Alexander Zverev delivered in the decisive matches as Europe reclaimed the trophy.

summary.en: Remco Evenepoel defended his men's individual time trial title at the UCI Road World Championships in Montreal on Sept 20, winning over 39.2km to keep the rainbow jersey. Marlen Reusser won the women's time trial on the same day. It was another dominant display from the Belgian against the clock.
summary.zh_hans: 9月20日蒙特利尔公路单车世锦赛，埃费内普尔成功卫冕男子个人计时赛冠军，在39.2公里赛道再披彩虹战衣。同日女子计时赛由罗伊瑟夺冠。这是埃费内普尔连续在世锦赛计时项目称王，巩固其计时赛之王地位。

summary.en: Ian Ho Yentou won silver in the men's 50m freestyle on Monday, clocking 21.76 seconds in a race featuring three sub-22-second swims. The Virginia Tech swimmer finished just 0.10 seconds behind South Korea's Kim Youngbeom, who took gold in a national record 21.66. The medal took Hong Kong's swimming tally to three on the second night in the pool and made Ho the first Hong Kong male swimmer on the podium in Nagoya.

summary.zh_hant: 何甄陶周一（21日）在男子50米自由泳決賽游出21秒76奪得銀牌，僅以0.10秒之差不敵游出韓國紀錄21秒66奪金的韓國泳手。這是港隊泳隊在第二個決賽晚的第三面獎牌，何甄陶亦成為今屆首位站上游泳頒獎台的港隊男泳手。

summary.en: China lost 70-79 to Iran in the Asian Games bronze-medal game, finishing fourth and missing the podium — the team's second-worst Asian Games result ever after 2014's fifth place. China led 31-29 at halftime, but a 13-4 Iran run in the third quarter turned the game; a late rally pulled China within 62-63 before Iran closed it out. Pang Zhenglin scored a game-high 22 points for China.
summary.zh_hans: 名古屋亚运会男篮铜牌战，中国男篮以70比79不敌伊朗，最终获得第四名无缘奖牌，创下自2014年仁川亚运会第五名以来的亚运最差战绩。上半场中国31比29领先，第三节伊朗打出13比4攻势反超；末节中国一度追至62比63仅差1分，但未能逆转。庞峥麟拿下全场最高的22分。
summary.zh_hant: 名古屋亞運會男籃銅牌戰，中國男籃以70比79不敵伊朗，最終獲得第四名無緣獎牌，創下自2014年仁川亞運會第五名以來的亞運最差戰績。上半場中國31比29領先，第三節伊朗打出13比4攻勢反超；末節中國一度追至62比63僅差1分，但未能逆轉。龐崢麟拿下全場最高的22分。

title.en: China Men Fall 70-79 to Iran in Bronze Match, End Asian Games Medal-Less in Fourth
